full_judgment: 2. Opposite party No. 1 Bijoy Kumar Roy, as preemptor, instituted Misc. Case Nos. 59-63 of 1988 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Thakurgaon, under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act against the present petitioners and opposite party Nos. 2-9 contending inter alia that the opposite party No. 3 namely Sankar Barman transferred 1.13 acres of land recorded in the C.S. plot 4955 under C.S. khatian No. 852 corresponding to S.A. khatian No. 744 of Mouza Hariharpur, P. S. and District Thakurgaon to the preemptee opposite parties by 5 kabalas dated 24.3.88, 28.3.88 and 31.3.88; that the petitioner is a holder of land contiguous to the case land and the purchaser opposite parties were strangers thereto; that the petitioner has 8/9/10 acres of land and that he is legally entitled to preempt the case land.
